# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Parameters
treatment_rate <- 0.005  # per child-week
control_rate <- 0.010    # per child-week
exposure_per_cluster <- 2500  # child-weeks
between_cluster_cv <- 0.25    # dimensionless
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90
allocation_ratio <- 1  # equal allocation

# Expected number of events per cluster (mean)
mu_t <- treatment_rate * exposure_per_cluster
mu_c <- control_rate * exposure_per_cluster

cat("Treatment rate (per child-week):", treatment_rate, "\n")
cat("Control rate (per child-week):", control_rate, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (child-weeks):", exposure_per_cluster, "\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", between_cluster_cv, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment):", mu_t, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control):", mu_c, "\n\n")

# Two-sided critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)

cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Z-value for alpha/2 (1 - 0.025):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("Z-value for power (", target_power, "):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# CV approximation formula for cluster-level rates
# The variance for cluster-level rate differences includes:
# 1. Poisson variation at individual level
# 2. Between-cluster variation captured via CV

# For equal allocation, the variance of rate difference is:
# Var(r_t - r_c) = Var(r_t) + Var(r_c)
# where Var(r) includes both Poisson and between-cluster components

# Under the CV approximation:
# Var(r_t) ≈ [mu_t + (mu_t * CV)^2] / exposure_per_cluster
# Var(r_c) ≈ [mu_c + (mu_c * CV)^2] / exposure_per_cluster

# For cluster-level aggregated data with Poisson base and gamma mixing:
# Variance includes: mu/exposure + (mu*CV)^2/exposure
# But the formula accounts for the between-cluster variance directly

# Using Hayes & Moulton formula for cluster-rate studies
# The effective variance for one cluster in each arm is:
# V_t = (1/mu_t + CV^2) / exposure_per_cluster  (approx. for treatment)
# V_c = (1/mu_c + CV^2) / exposure_per_cluster  (approx. for control)

# More precisely, for counts Y ~ negative binomial (Poisson-gamma mixture):
# Var(Y) = mu + (mu * CV)^2
# For rates, Var(rate) = Var(count) / exposure^2

# Hayes & Moulton Section 6.1 uses:
# Var of cluster rate = (1 + k*mu*CV^2) / (k*mu)
# where k is the number of observations per cluster (here: exposure_per_cluster)

k <- exposure_per_cluster

# Variance for treatment arm (per cluster)
var_rate_t <- (1 + k * mu_t * (between_cluster_cv^2)) / (k * mu_t)

# Variance for control arm (per cluster)
var_rate_c <- (1 + k * mu_c * (between_cluster_cv^2)) / (k * mu_c)

cat("Variance of cluster rate (treatment):", var_rate_t, "\n")
cat("Variance of cluster rate (control):", var_rate_c, "\n\n")

# Rate difference
rate_diff <- treatment_rate - control_rate
cat("Rate difference (treatment - control):", rate_diff, "\n\n")

# For equal allocation with m clusters per arm:
# Var(rate_diff) = var_rate_t/m + var_rate_c/m = (var_rate_t + var_rate_c)/m

# Sample size formula: m = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / (rate_diff)^2

m_continuous <- ((z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_rate_t + var_rate_c)) / (rate_diff^2)

cat("Continuous sample size (clusters per arm, before correction):", m_continuous, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction (Hayes & Moulton)
# This is a finite-sample continuity adjustment
m_with_correction <- m_continuous + 1

cat("Sample size with one-cluster additive correction:", m_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Round upward to ensure power meets or exceeds target
m_rounded <- ceiling(m_with_correction)

cat("Sample size rounded upward (clusters per arm):", m_rounded, "\n")
cat("Total clusters:", m_rounded * 2, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at rounded design
# For verification, calculate power at m_rounded
m_check <- m_rounded

# Variance of rate difference with m_check clusters per arm
var_diff_check <- (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / m_check

# Standard error
se_diff_check <- sqrt(var_diff_check)

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp_check <- rate_diff / se_diff_check

# Achieved power (two-sided)
achieved_power <- 2 * pnorm(ncp_check - z_alpha) - 1

cat("Verification at m =", m_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Variance of rate difference:", var_diff_check, "\n")
cat("Standard error of rate difference:", se_diff_check, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_check, "\n")
cat("Achieved power (two-sided):", round(achieved_power, 6), "\n\n")

# Also verify power at m_rounded - 1 to show rounding impact
if (m_rounded > 1) {
  m_prev <- m_rounded - 1
  var_diff_prev <- (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / m_prev
  se_diff_prev <- sqrt(var_diff_prev)
  ncp_prev <- rate_diff / se_diff_prev
  achieved_power_prev <- 2 * pnorm(ncp_prev - z_alpha) - 1
  
  cat("Verification at m =", m_prev, "(preceding admissible design):\n")
  cat("Variance of rate difference:", var_diff_prev, "\n")
  cat("Standard error of rate difference:", se_diff_prev, "\n")
  cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_prev, "\n")
  cat("Achieved power (two-sided):", round(achieved_power_prev, 6), "\n\n")
}

# Final result
POWER_AGENT_RESULT=jsonlite::toJSON(list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = m_rounded, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(achieved_power, 6), unit = "proportion")
  ),
  study_design = list(
    method = "cluster_rate_cv",
    treatment_rate = treatment_rate,
    control_rate = control_rate,
    exposure_per_cluster = exposure_per_cluster,
    between_cluster_cv = between_cluster_cv,
    alpha = alpha,
    target_power = target_power,
    sidedness = "two-sided",
    allocation_ratio = 1
  )
), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Parameters
treatment_rate <- 0.005  # per child-week
control_rate <- 0.010    # per child-week
exposure_per_cluster <- 2500  # child-weeks
between_cluster_cv <- 0.25    # dimensionless
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90
allocation_ratio <- 1  # equal allocation

# Expected number of events per cluster (mean)
mu_t <- treatment_rate * exposure_per_cluster
mu_c <- control_rate * exposure_per_cluster

cat("Treatment rate (per child-week):", treatment_rate, "\n")
cat("Control rate (per child-week):", control_rate, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (child-weeks):", exposure_per_cluster, "\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", between_cluster_cv, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment):", mu_t, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control):", mu_c, "\n\n")

# Two-sided critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)

cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Z-value for alpha/2 (1 - 0.025):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("Z-value for power (", target_power, "):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# CV approximation formula for cluster-level rates
# The variance for cluster-level rate differences includes:
# 1. Poisson variation at individual level
# 2. Between-cluster variation captured via CV

# For equal allocation, the variance of rate difference is:
# Var(r_t - r_c) = Var(r_t) + Var(r_c)
# where Var(r) includes both Poisson and between-cluster components

# Under the CV approximation:
# Var(r_t) ≈ [mu_t + (mu_t * CV)^2] / exposure_per_cluster
# Var(r_c) ≈ [mu_c + (mu_c * CV)^2] / exposure_per_cluster

# For cluster-level aggregated data with Poisson base and gamma mixing:
# Variance includes: mu/exposure + (mu*CV)^2/exposure
# But the formula accounts for the between-cluster variance directly

# Using Hayes & Moulton formula for cluster-rate studies
# The effective variance for one cluster in each arm is:
# V_t = (1/mu_t + CV^2) / exposure_per_cluster  (approx. for treatment)
# V_c = (1/mu_c + CV^2) / exposure_per_cluster  (approx. for control)

# More precisely, for counts Y ~ negative binomial (Poisson-gamma mixture):
# Var(Y) = mu + (mu * CV)^2
# For rates, Var(rate) = Var(count) / exposure^2

# Hayes & Moulton Section 6.1 uses:
# Var of cluster rate = (1 + k*mu*CV^2) / (k*mu)
# where k is the number of observations per cluster (here: exposure_per_cluster)

k <- exposure_per_cluster

# Variance for treatment arm (per cluster)
var_rate_t <- (1 + k * mu_t * (between_cluster_cv^2)) / (k * mu_t)

# Variance for control arm (per cluster)
var_rate_c <- (1 + k * mu_c * (between_cluster_cv^2)) / (k * mu_c)

cat("Variance of cluster rate (treatment):", var_rate_t, "\n")
cat("Variance of cluster rate (control):", var_rate_c, "\n\n")

# Rate difference
rate_diff <- treatment_rate - control_rate
cat("Rate difference (treatment - control):", rate_diff, "\n\n")

# For equal allocation with m clusters per arm:
# Var(rate_diff) = var_rate_t/m + var_rate_c/m = (var_rate_t + var_rate_c)/m

# Sample size formula: m = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / (rate_diff)^2

m_continuous <- ((z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_rate_t + var_rate_c)) / (rate_diff^2)

cat("Continuous sample size (clusters per arm, before correction):", m_continuous, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction (Hayes & Moulton)
# This is a finite-sample continuity adjustment
m_with_correction <- m_continuous + 1

cat("Sample size with one-cluster additive correction:", m_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Round upward to ensure power meets or exceeds target
m_rounded <- ceiling(m_with_correction)

cat("Sample size rounded upward (clusters per arm):", m_rounded, "\n")
cat("Total clusters:", m_rounded * 2, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at rounded design
# For verification, calculate power at m_rounded
m_check <- m_rounded

# Variance of rate difference with m_check clusters per arm
var_diff_check <- (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / m_check

# Standard error
se_diff_check <- sqrt(var_diff_check)

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp_check <- rate_diff / se_diff_check

# Achieved power (two-sided)
achieved_power <- 2 * pnorm(ncp_check - z_alpha) - 1

cat("Verification at m =", m_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Variance of rate difference:", var_diff_check, "\n")
cat("Standard error of rate difference:", se_diff_check, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_check, "\n")
cat("Achieved power (two-sided):", round(achieved_power, 6), "\n\n")

# Also verify power at m_rounded - 1 to show rounding impact
if (m_rounded > 1) {
  m_prev <- m_rounded - 1
  var_diff_prev <- (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / m_prev
  se_diff_prev <- sqrt(var_diff_prev)
  ncp_prev <- rate_diff / se_diff_prev
  achieved_power_prev <- 2 * pnorm(ncp_prev - z_alpha) - 1
  
  cat("Verification at m =", m_prev, "(preceding admissible design):\n")
  cat("Variance of rate difference:", var_diff_prev, "\n")
  cat("Standard error of rate difference:", se_diff_prev, "\n")
  cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_prev, "\n")
  cat("Achieved power (two-sided):", round(achieved_power_prev, 6), "\n\n")
}

# Final result
POWER_AGENT_RESULT=jsonlite::toJSON(list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = m_rounded, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(achieved_power, 6), unit = "proportion")
  ),
  study_design = list(
    method = "cluster_rate_cv",
    treatment_rate = treatment_rate,
    control_rate = control_rate,
    exposure_per_cluster = exposure_per_cluster,
    between_cluster_cv = between_cluster_cv,
    alpha = alpha,
    target_power = target_power,
    sidedness = "two-sided",
    allocation_ratio = 1
  )
), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)

# Evidence e1; success=true

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Parameters
treatment_rate <- 0.005  # per child-week
control_rate <- 0.010    # per child-week
exposure_per_cluster <- 2500  # child-weeks
between_cluster_cv <- 0.25    # dimensionless
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90
allocation_ratio <- 1  # equal allocation

# Expected number of events per cluster (mean)
mu_t <- treatment_rate * exposure_per_cluster
mu_c <- control_rate * exposure_per_cluster

cat("Treatment rate (per child-week):", treatment_rate, "\n")
cat("Control rate (per child-week):", control_rate, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (child-weeks):", exposure_per_cluster, "\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", between_cluster_cv, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment):", mu_t, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control):", mu_c, "\n\n")

# Two-sided critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)

cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Z-value for alpha/2 (1 - 0.025):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("Z-value for power (", target_power, "):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# CV approximation formula for cluster-level rates
# The variance for cluster-level rate differences includes:
# 1. Poisson variation at individual level
# 2. Between-cluster variation captured via CV

# For equal allocation, the variance of rate difference is:
# Var(r_t - r_c) = Var(r_t) + Var(r_c)
# where Var(r) includes both Poisson and between-cluster components

# Under the CV approximation:
# Var(r_t) ≈ [mu_t + (mu_t * CV)^2] / exposure_per_cluster
# Var(r_c) ≈ [mu_c + (mu_c * CV)^2] / exposure_per_cluster

# For cluster-level aggregated data with Poisson base and gamma mixing:
# Variance includes: mu/exposure + (mu*CV)^2/exposure
# But the formula accounts for the between-cluster variance directly

# Using Hayes & Moulton formula for cluster-rate studies
# The effective variance for one cluster in each arm is:
# V_t = (1/mu_t + CV^2) / exposure_per_cluster  (approx. for treatment)
# V_c = (1/mu_c + CV^2) / exposure_per_cluster  (approx. for control)

# More precisely, for counts Y ~ negative binomial (Poisson-gamma mixture):
# Var(Y) = mu + (mu * CV)^2
# For rates, Var(rate) = Var(count) / exposure^2

# Hayes & Moulton Section 6.1 uses:
# Var of cluster rate = (1 + k*mu*CV^2) / (k*mu)
# where k is the number of observations per cluster (here: exposure_per_cluster)

k <- exposure_per_cluster

# Variance for treatment arm (per cluster)
var_rate_t <- (1 + k * mu_t * (between_cluster_cv^2)) / (k * mu_t)

# Variance for control arm (per cluster)
var_rate_c <- (1 + k * mu_c * (between_cluster_cv^2)) / (k * mu_c)

cat("Variance of cluster rate (treatment):", var_rate_t, "\n")
cat("Variance of cluster rate (control):", var_rate_c, "\n\n")

# Rate difference
rate_diff <- treatment_rate - control_rate
cat("Rate difference (treatment - control):", rate_diff, "\n\n")

# For equal allocation with m clusters per arm:
# Var(rate_diff) = var_rate_t/m + var_rate_c/m = (var_rate_t + var_rate_c)/m

# Sample size formula: m = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / (rate_diff)^2

m_continuous <- ((z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_rate_t + var_rate_c)) / (rate_diff^2)

cat("Continuous sample size (clusters per arm, before correction):", m_continuous, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction (Hayes & Moulton)
# This is a finite-sample continuity adjustment
m_with_correction <- m_continuous + 1

cat("Sample size with one-cluster additive correction:", m_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Round upward to ensure power meets or exceeds target
m_rounded <- ceiling(m_with_correction)

cat("Sample size rounded upward (clusters per arm):", m_rounded, "\n")
cat("Total clusters:", m_rounded * 2, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at rounded design
# For verification, calculate power at m_rounded
m_check <- m_rounded

# Variance of rate difference with m_check clusters per arm
var_diff_check <- (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / m_check

# Standard error
se_diff_check <- sqrt(var_diff_check)

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp_check <- rate_diff / se_diff_check

# Achieved power (two-sided)
achieved_power <- 2 * pnorm(ncp_check - z_alpha) - 1

cat("Verification at m =", m_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Variance of rate difference:", var_diff_check, "\n")
cat("Standard error of rate difference:", se_diff_check, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_check, "\n")
cat("Achieved power (two-sided):", round(achieved_power, 6), "\n\n")

# Also verify power at m_rounded - 1 to show rounding impact
if (m_rounded > 1) {
  m_prev <- m_rounded - 1
  var_diff_prev <- (var_rate_t + var_rate_c) / m_prev
  se_diff_prev <- sqrt(var_diff_prev)
  ncp_prev <- rate_diff / se_diff_prev
  achieved_power_prev <- 2 * pnorm(ncp_prev - z_alpha) - 1
  
  cat("Verification at m =", m_prev, "(preceding admissible design):\n")
  cat("Variance of rate difference:", var_diff_prev, "\n")
  cat("Standard error of rate difference:", se_diff_prev, "\n")
  cat("Non-centrality parameter:", ncp_prev, "\n")
  cat("Achieved power (two-sided):", round(achieved_power_prev, 6), "\n\n")
}

# Final result
POWER_AGENT_RESULT=jsonlite::toJSON(list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = m_rounded, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(achieved_power, 6), unit = "proportion")
  ),
  study_design = list(
    method = "cluster_rate_cv",
    treatment_rate = treatment_rate,
    control_rate = control_rate,
    exposure_per_cluster = exposure_per_cluster,
    between_cluster_cv = between_cluster_cv,
    alpha = alpha,
    target_power = target_power,
    sidedness = "two-sided",
    allocation_ratio = 1
  )
), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
